title: RF pipeline: record how to plan a batch (candidates, plan sitting, sizing, order, issue, running, close-out)
acceptance: agent-prompts/rf-pipeline.md gains a "Planning a batch" section the conductor follows before asking the owner to approve a batch issue. It covers: checking § 7.3 against where touched code actually lives; treating 'decide' lines as decisions; a plan sitting with one read-only planner per feature and one owner ask; sizing the queue from measured throughput; ordering by shared files; creating the issue before its start and recording mid-batch owner decisions as issue comments; running with a blocking build-machine wait loop and merge-not-force updates; and close-out.
ritmofit_dev_plan/two-machine-rules.md § 7.3's "No plan needed" check also accepts a plan the owner confirmed in the owner's own words quoted in the issue, matching how #241 batched three features.

evidence.summary: The batch whose planning and run this section records, with #233 before it. The owner asked to record the workflow for future batches in the Neo conductor session on 2026-11-25.
This task's PR; its body quotes the owner's ask of 2026-11-25.

resolution: agent-prompts/rf-pipeline.md › Planning a batch records the method from iOS batches #233 and #241, including the lessons from RF-1122's late ineligibility, RF-1182's plan departure, the 9-minute issue timing slip and the build-machine overlaps; § 7.3 now accepts a plan the owner confirmed in the issue.
